pairs: And so, these things having been transacted,
factus est sermo Domini ad Abram per visionem dicens:
the word of the Lord came to Abram by a vision, saying:
ego protector tuus sum, et merces tua magna nimis.
I am your protector, and your reward is exceedingly great.”
what will you give to me?
et filius procuratoris domus meæ iste Damascus Eliezer.
And the son of the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus.”
“Yet to me you have not given offspring.
my servant born in my house will be my heir.”
Statimque sermo Domini factus est ad eum,
And immediately the word of the Lord came to him,
“This one will not be your heir.
sed qui egredietur de utero tuo,
But he who will come from your loins,
the same will you have for your heir.”
et reputatum est illi ad justitiam.
and it was reputed to him unto justice.
Ego Dominus qui eduxi te de Ur Chaldæorum ut darem tibi terram istam,
“I am the Lord who led you away from Ur of the Chaldeans, so as to give you this land,
and so that you would possess it.”
unde scire possum quod possessurus sim eam?
in what way may I be able to know that I will possess it?”
And the Lord responded by saying:
“Take for me a cow of three years,
et capram trimam, et arietem annorum trium,
and a she-goat of three years, and a ram of three years,
also a turtle-dove and a pigeon.”
he divided them through the middle,
et utrasque partes contra se altrinsecus posuit;
and placed both parts opposite one another.
But the birds he did not divide.
And birds descended upon the carcasses,
And when the sun was setting,
a deep sleep fell upon Abram,
et horror magnus et tenebrosus invasit eum.
and a dread, great and dark, invaded him.
And it was said to him:
Scito prænoscens quod peregrinum futurum sit semen tuum in terra non sua,
“Know beforehand that your future offspring will be sojourners in a land not their own,
and they will subjugate them in servitude
and afflict them for four hundred years.
Yet truly, I will judge the nation that they will serve,
ego judicabo: et post hæc egredientur cum magna substantia.
and after this they will depart with great substance.
Tu autem ibis ad patres tuos in pace,
But you will go to your fathers in peace
and be buried at a good old age.
But in the fourth generation, they will return here.
necdum enim completæ sunt iniquitates Amorrhæorum usque ad præsens tempus.
For the iniquities of the Amorites are not yet completed, even to this present time.”
et lampas ignis transiens inter divisiones illas.
and there appeared a smoking furnace and a lamp of fire passing between those divisions.
In illo die pepigit Dominus fœdus cum Abram,
On that day, God formed a covenant with Abram,
Semini tuo dabo terram hanc a fluvio Ægypti usque ad fluvium magnum Euphraten,
“To your offspring I will give this land, from the river of Egypt, even to the great river Euphrates:
